test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statement:

Some branches are leaves.

Some leaves are cables.

Conclusion:

(I) Atleast some cables are branches.

(II) Some cables are leaves.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685cb8162257db79b6c7922e7c7cb07320850f1f40cb0beb4f9afec924950228.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Atleast some cables are branches → Does not follow (As some branches are leaves and some leaves are cables. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some cables are leaves → Follow (As some leaves are cables. As some part of leaves is common with cables, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**"
